questions.question: Which CSS property is used to set the text color?
questions.explanation: The 'color' property is used to set the text color in CSS. For example: color: blue;

questions.question: Which CSS property is used to set the background color of an element?
questions.explanation: The 'background-color' property is used to set the background color of an element. For example: background-color: #ffffff;

questions.question: Which of the following is a valid way to specify the color red in CSS?
options: By name, hexadecimal, RGB, or RGBA
questions.explanation: You can specify colors in CSS using color names (red), hexadecimal values (#ff0000), RGB (rgb(255, 0, 0)), or RGBA (rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)) for colors with transparency.

questions.question: What does the hexadecimal color value #FF0000 represent?
questions.explanation: Hexadecimal color values use RGB format. #FF0000 represents red (FF for red, 00 for green, 00 for blue).

questions.question: What does the hexadecimal color value #000000 represent?
questions.explanation: #000000 represents black, as all color channels (red, green, blue) are set to 00 (the minimum value).

questions.question: What does the hexadecimal color value #FFFFFF represent?
questions.explanation: #FFFFFF represents white, as all color channels (red, green, blue) are set to FF (the maximum value).

questions.question: What is the correct RGB syntax for the color red?
questions.explanation: RGB syntax uses rgb(red, green, blue) where each value is 0-255. For red: rgb(255, 0, 0) means maximum red, no green, no blue.

questions.question: What does RGBA add that RGB doesn't have?
questions.explanation: RGBA adds an alpha channel (the 'A') which controls transparency/opacity. The alpha value ranges from 0 (fully transparent) to 1 (fully opaque).

questions.question: What is the correct RGBA syntax for semi-transparent red?
questions.explanation: RGBA syntax is rgba(red, green, blue, alpha) where alpha is 0-1. rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5) creates semi-transparent red (50% opacity).

questions.question: Which CSS property is used to set the border color?
questions.explanation: The 'border-color' property is used to set the color of an element's border. You can also set it as part of the 'border' shorthand property.
The text color uses hexadecimal format (#333333, which is a dark gray). The background uses RGB (rgb(255, 255, 255) which is white), and the border uses a color name (blue).

questions.question: What is a color palette tool that was mentioned in the CSS Color resources?
questions.explanation: coolors.co is one of the color resources mentioned in the CSS Color resource page. It's a tool for generating and exploring color palettes.
